userValue: Developers and agents can find the current project entry, import the correct WeChat project, and run Harness without stale guidance, ignored-file false failures or silently ignored arguments.
nonGoals: Do not change product runtime, API, database, deployment or user-visible behavior.
Do not add a new documentation hierarchy, approval layer, verification profile or concurrency system.
Do not delete compatibility pages or historical release evidence.
Do not absorb personal WeChat DevTools configuration into this task.
